Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 25.67% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc bought 12,372 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 60,577 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.16M, up from 48,205 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $944.84B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $192.23. About 2.51M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 13, 2017 and is uptrending.
